resources.string: Touch and hold the wallpaper in the upper-right corner of the home screen to choose a picture.
Tap the gear button on the left to manage authentication, connection settings, appearance, and system options.
Tap the chain button on the left to view connected devices, show QR codes, check client logs, and manage keys.
Tap the bottom button on the left to open the permissions window. Check storage, notification, and background access, and grant permissions as needed.
